question: What is the best method for disposing of hazardous waste?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Incineration**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Incineration **

 
 
• Incineration **involves burning waste at high temperatures to reduce its volume and eliminate harmful components.**
 
• Incineration is **considered one of the most effective methods for disposing of hazardous waste **because it can destroy toxic substances, including chemicals and medical waste, rendering them safer.
 
• **Modern incinerators are equipped with advanced filtering systems to capture pollutants and minimize environmental impact.**
 
• Items like **syringes, bandages, and contaminated materials** are often incinerated to prevent the spread of infections and diseases.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Land Disposal**

 
 
• A c**ommon method for hazardous waste disposal**, but it has environmental risks.
 
• Land disposal** can involve landfilling or underground injection.**
 
• Landfills are sites where waste is buried in the ground.
 
 
 
• **Ocean Dumping**:
 
 
• Ocean dumping involves disposing of waste materials into the ocean.
 
• This is **highly harmful to marine life and ecosystems**.
 
• **Ocean dumping is illegal in many countries **due to its destructive environmental impact**​**
 
 

 
• Composting:

 
 
• Composting is the **process of breaking down organic waste (like food scraps, leaves, etc.) into nutrient-rich soil.**
 
• This process occurs naturally, but composting can be managed to speed up decomposition and create usable soil.
 
• Composting is an **aerobic process, meaning it requires oxygen.**
